E2 shows that a related Hf-containing alloy (W29Ta42Cr5V16Hf8) exhibited no precipitates at 10 dpa, supporting the premise that Hf can suppress precipitation. However, the cited evidence does not directly demonstrate that Hf increases lattice distortion to retard diffusion, nor does it address the effects on hardening, radiation resistance, or bulk manufacturability of the proposed Hf-modified W38Ta36Cr15V11 composition.
